# Selling an Inherited Home in Folsom

> A free guide to selling an inherited house in Folsom, CA, by Scott Kirk, Broker/Owner, Weichert, Realtors - Sierra Pacific Group (CA DRE 01879787, corporate DRE 02088790), 705 Gold Lake Dr., Suite 250, Folsom, CA 95630, 916-847-5822, scott@wrspg.com. Each answer gives the California rule and links to the source. Sales figures come from MetroList, the regional MLS.

## Pages

- [Selling an Inherited Home in Folsom, CA | Scott Kirk](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/): How to sell an inherited house in Folsom, CA: probate, taxes, first steps and value, one question at a time. By Scott Kirk, Broker/Owner, Weichert, Realtors® - Sierra Pacific Group.
- [Does an Inherited House in Folsom Have to Go Through Probate? | 2026](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/probate): Trust, small estate, the $750,000 main home petition, or full probate, plus the minimum probate timeline set by California law.
- [Can I Sell an Inherited House in Folsom During Probate? | 2026](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/selling-during-probate): Full vs limited authority, the Notice of Proposed Action, the probate referee's appraisal, the 90 percent rule and overbids.
- [What Taxes Apply When You Inherit a House in Folsom? | 2026](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/taxes): The step up in basis and Prop 19 for an inherited house in Folsom, CA, with the 2025 to 2027 exclusion cap and the claim deadline.
- [What Should I Do First With an Inherited House in Folsom? | Checklist](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/first-30-days): Week one and month one after inheriting a house in Folsom, CA: protect it, make four calls, gather the paperwork.
- [What Happens to a Reverse Mortgage When a Parent Dies in Folsom? | 2026](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/reverse-mortgage): When a parent with a reverse mortgage dies, heirs can pay it off, sell, or sign the house over. HUD's 30 day clock, the 95 percent rule, and why probate timing matters in Folsom.
- [Common Questions About Inherited Homes in Folsom | Scott Kirk](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/questions): Short, sourced answers to the questions Folsom families ask about an inherited house: probate, reverse mortgages, value, taxes and the first 30 days.
- [What Is My Inherited House in Folsom Worth? | 2026 Medians](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/value): Folsom neighborhood median sale prices from MetroList, the two values an inherited home needs, and how to price a house that needs work.
- [Video: selling an inherited house in Folsom](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/video): Scott Kirk's 9 minute walkthrough: who can sell, probate, value, capital gains and Prop 19, with chapters and the full transcript.
- [Selling the home we inherited: a Folsom family's story](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/story): Susan S., in her own words and with her permission, on how she and her sister decided between fixing up and selling as is their late father's Folsom home, with Scott Kirk.
- [Folsom inherited house by the numbers](https://sellinginheritedhomefolsom.com/numbers): Sourced figures on probate thresholds, timelines, the 90 percent rule, overbids, Prop 19, the step up in basis and Folsom estate sales, one per line with date and source.
